note: Mostly long-term: about 32 of its 89 sites are sold by the night. Private park just off I-24 exit 11 at Paducah, run by Streamside Parks under its SteadyStays long-term brand. The nightly pull-throughs sit near the entrance; the back-ins along the stocked pond at the east end are long-term. Seasonal pool, dog park and pet wash, propane. --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE: price $55 weekday / $65 Saturday (over $50, no gateway within 40 km, not a Good Sam Park) and mostly long-term (32 of 89 sites nightly) under a long-term-living brand. Otherwise confirmed: full hookups 50A, 89 sites, year-round, Campspot white-label booking. Website moved to steadystays.com. Google 4.4/498. Not waterfront stands for the nightly sites.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - PRICE GATE: cheapest RV night $55 before tax (book.steadystays.com 'STARTING AT $55.00'; dated searches $58 incl. $3 fee on weekdays in June 2027, January 2027 and December 2026), $65 on Saturdays (summer peak = $65). audit/price_research/gateways.py 37.0211,-88.58719: 'none within 40 km; nearest: Nashville 187 km'. Good Sam stored false. The stored discounts.military true (Good Sam directory, derived) would give a military-only 10% ($49.50), not a general discount; no member discount on the operator's pages ('Nothing to share yet' under specials).

LONG-STAY: the park is marketed under SteadyStays ('welcoming, reliable communities for long-term RV living'), and 'Our RV campground is the ideal spot for extended or monthly stays'. Only the two online nightly types, 32 sites (01-08, 10-17, 43-58), are sold by the night out of 89 (~36%). Mostly long-term; with the over-$50 price this is the 'mostly seasonal AND iffy' case. Note leads with it. Counter-evidence: 2025 reviews describe overnight stops, Google 4.4 over 498.

WATERFRONT: stays not waterfront. The park map and imagery put sites 84-86, 88-100 and DC1-DC4 on the open bank of a ~0.5 ha stocked pond (about 37.0206,-88.5838; RVs within ~5-15 m), which would be 'pond', but none of those are sold nightly (the nightly sites 01-17 and 43-58 are 100-300 m west). The big fenced lagoon east of the park is outside it.

WEBSITE: https://www.duckcreekrvpark.com/ -> https://steadystays.com/duck-creek-rv-park-paducah-ky/ (the old domain now serves the SteadyStays page). Phone 270-415-0404 confirmed. Booking https://book.steadystays.com/kentucky/duck-creek-rv-park-paducah-kentucky/search.
